name: Discover Rolf's Fate
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details:
Upon further searching the area, you find webbed footprints leading east along the shore of Stone Cairn Lake.  In the distance to the east, you can just barely see a Murloc village.

Perhaps Rolf's fate ended there...
narrative.objectives: Search the murloc village for Rolf, or signs of his death.
narrative.offerRewardText: You find around the neck of the corpse a metal medallion inscribed with the words "Footman Rolf Hartford."

chain.subtitle: 7 quests at level 10, 2,605 XP in all.

quests.name: A Fishy Peril
quests.objectiveText: Remy "Two Times" wants you to speak with Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

quests.name: Further Concerns
quests.objectiveText: Marshal Dughan wants you to speak with Guard Thomas.

quests.name: Find the Lost Guards
quests.objectiveText: Guard Thomas wants you to travel north up the river and search for the two lost guards, Rolf and Malakai.

quests.name: Discover Rolf's Fate
quests.objectiveText: Search the murloc village for Rolf, or signs of his death.

quests.name: Report to Thomas
quests.objectiveText: Deliver Rolf and Malakai's Medallions to Guard Thomas at the eastern Elwynn bridge.

quests.name: Deliver Thomas' Report
quests.objectiveText: Report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

quests.name: Cloth and Leather Armor
quests.objectiveText: Give Sara Timberlain the Stormwind Armor Marker.
